capabilities: Emulate mobile view and cycle view modes and installed themes via commands
Toggle light/dark mode and devtools with hotkeys
Freeze the app to style transient elements like tooltips and menus
Add debugging aids such as red outlines and a toggleable test class
Open a cheatsheet of Obsidian CSS classes and show the Chrome version
extras: Docs also point to external resources and cheatsheets that work without installing the plugin.
intentEvidence: Some utilities and Quality-of-Life features for designers of Obsidian themes.
problem: Theme designers need quick ways to inspect and test how their CSS renders across modes, devices and transient UI elements, which Obsidian does not expose conveniently.

relations.evidence: As opposed to the Theme Switcher Plugin, this does not open a modal
You can change the colors by editing the CSS snippet, or using the Style Settings plugin

summary: Command collection with developer tools (devtools, mobile emulation, theme cycling, debug outlines) and sample files for designing Obsidian themes.
